ciAtTheHead.state: The handoff head carries no run of its own (handoff-only push, skip-checks: true). The code head 89ce0fbf has CI run 41059086197, created at 12:55Z; at 13:46Z only its changes job had finished, green, and every other job was queued, the pi-envoy job this round turns on included. A lane still running is read as running and never waited for. The run before it, 41029729106 at the retro head b2d4f76d, is the only run of this branch ever to finish red, and it failed in pi-envoy and ci-ok alone, for the reason the proof above gives. Every other run since round 2 ended cancelled by the next push; the last run to finish green is 40959437771 at f2df6dc7. The reviewer and the merger read ci-ok at the merging head, as DA-4 binds acceptance 3.

observations.what: The branch runs the pi-envoy job on every head because it edits ci.yaml, and that job is the one place main's drift can turn this pull request red.
observations.evidence: pi_envoy's filter names .github/workflows/ci.yaml (ci.yaml:609), as most filters do, so a head of this branch runs a TypeScript job whose code it never touches. That is how run 41029729106 went red on main's own card-delivery test at a base three hours stale. The lesson for the merge: a long wait between the last merge of main and the merge itself is the risk here, not this change.
